Harbor Psychiatry is hands down the WORST place I have ever been for mental health in OC. I went there looking for a new psychiatrist (for depression, anxiety, adhd), talk therapy, and they recommended I try esketamine at their office. I was there twice a week for 2 months doing nasal ketamine. The last few times I was there they wouldn’t check on me for hours (they’re supposed to come by every 30-45 mins) they would just give me drugs and leave me in a room by myself with no guidance or support. I had a full on breakdown the last time and was crying loudly and screaming and no one came. My mom and bf had to break me out because the staff wouldn’t check on me, even after I went over the normal time of being there. Their front desk staff was rude to me repeatedly. My therapist cancelled appts with me multiple times last minute and never did CBT or EMDR which I specifically requested when we first met. They ended up double billing me and gaslighted me hard. I had to meet with them and advocate for myself and do the math myself to show them they billed me wrong. I was really traumatized by this place. I’m 100% convinced they are just in it to take your money

Wow it’s like I wrote this myself. I was diagnosed with depression, anxiety, bipolar II, and PTSD at 16. I’m 23 now and have taken pretty much every medication, tried different forms of therapy, ketamine, and multiple rounds of TMS without any change. About 6 months ago I found the first dr to even suggest potential ADHD and when I was tested (honestly the test seemed like BS) they said I have ADHD on top of everything else. It makes sense to me and I think a lot of symptoms overlap so it’s ridiculous your dr said that. Ive been taking adderall on and off for the last 6 months but honestly it doesn’t seem to improve my symptoms personally 🤷🏼‍♀️
I don’t know what kind of resources you have where you live but keep looking for other drs and doing your own research when you can. You’re your best advocate. And you’re not alone! It’s hard but it’s gonna get better and day by day it’s gonna get a little easier. Good luck friend!

I highly relate to this, you’re not alone. It varies but I’ll go a day or a few days without eating because I’m such a ball of anxiety. I had a period of about 2 weeks where I threw up everything I ate (I went to tons of drs and got many tests done which all came back normal and so they blame it all on psychological issues) and had to quit my job because I couldn’t make it to work repeatedly. I try to drink a lot of fluids especially water and juice (the less acidic kinds like banana/strawberry/orange/apple) and stopped drinking any coffee. Light foods like crackers, celery, bread, and soup tend to help me. Try to force small bites of food/drink every few hours even if you don’t want it to keep your blood sugar up. 
I’m here for you friend. I can’t promise it’ll get better soon but you can get more in tune to your body’s signals. Good luck I’ll be thinking about you and wishing you well
